gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hanuman: Disorder sprawls raw and chaotic, its round letters scattered with no swelling at the stems. Hanuman, a refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase, gives all that mess a traditional, dignified spine to lean on.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-kadwa: Chaotic and raw, Disorder draws its letters like neon tubing, every stroke the same width and spaced apart. Kadwa, a classic serif, settles things with editorial polish.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is an authoritative serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with an e pried wide open. And Disorder, with its jittery strokes that never swell or taper, gives that refined text a restless edge to push against.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-pridi: Pridi reads like a classic, refined serif, its small letters standing proud and almost capital-sized. Disorder, whose strokes end as wide as they begin, feels like graffiti scrawled beside a library shelf.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with large open counters throughout. Disorder crashes in above it with raw, widely spaced letters of uniform stroke, and the classic serif below keeps its footing.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum is a dignified, editorial serif with an open c and a high, squared-off x-height. Suwannaphum would carry a long passage steadily beneath Disorder, whose every stroke looks traced with a single stylus.
gen-dafont-disorder-instrument-sans: Disorder arrives chaotic and raw, with widely spaced letters and a tall lowercase. Instrument Sans, a plain sans with pincer-like open c ends and unvarying strokes, stays out of its way and lets the heading make the noise.
gen-dafont-disorder-inter: Raw and chaotic, Disorder sets the scene with spaced-out letters. Inter, a sans with big counters and smooth, tube-like lines, would stay easy to follow across paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-disorder-mulish: Mulish is a modern, approachable plain sans with horseshoe-open apertures and no thick-and-thin modulation whatsoever. Shrink Disorder, though, and its chaos fades.
gen-dafont-disorder-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab is a precise slab-serif whose open-throated a, c, e and s make the middle of each line dominate. Shrink Disorder and its diagonals lose their punch.
